verdict.rationale: Cline's own docs show it fixing test failures ("run tests and fix failures"), making linter-aware fixes, and running tests live. Its general file-editing and terminal powers suggest it could handle the other chores, but those are not documented as features. missing for 10: explicit evidence of writing new tests, resolving merge conflicts, updating dependencies, independent hands-on corroboration of these chores

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent write tests, fix lint errors, resolve merge conflicts, and update dependencies for me

citations.quote: cline --auto-approve true "run tests and fix failures"
Coordinated multi-file changes with linter-aware fixes, diffs, checkpoints, and one-click undo on every step.
Long-running dev servers, tests, deploys, all handled live.
It can read and write files, run terminal commands, use a browser, and help you build features through natural conversation.
